name: Local dev servers
ownerWords: A 200 check is a good duty too. Hand the 200 checks of the wiki, the frontend app, Convex and the crawler API in the local environment to the ops chat. Also, on 10-09: have it your duty to have usable mac.
goal: The owner's Mac stays usable (no minute in the last 24 h that the Mac usable watch reads unusable, the same line d7 judges by) and its search app :5174 and design demo :5180 answer 200, the wiki (the wiki url in hosts.json), the search app (localhost:5174), local Convex and the local crawler-v3 API each answer 200 within 5 s, the wiki's process tree stays under 4096 MB, and the wiki or search restarts at most once a day. Tell the owner only when a server does not answer, the wiki is over its cap, a server keeps restarting, or the Mac is overloaded.

metrics.label: Real memory of the wiki's process tree (llm-wiki.service on us-metal02, pm2 elsewhere)
Restarts of the wiki (systemd or pm2) or search (pm2) since the last run
Minutes in the last 24 h the owner's Mac read unusable (memory pressure critical, 6,000 or more swapouts a second, or kernel_task over one core)
The owner's Mac dev servers not answering 200 within 5 s: search app :5174 and design demo :5180 (an asleep Mac reads mac_unreachable instead)

onMiss: Read the flagged items; each service's answer is there, and by_design means the search app uses a remote one. Wiki not answering, over its cap or restarting: on us-metal02 read `journalctl --user -u llm-wiki.service -n 200 --no-pager`, find the cause, and run `systemctl --user restart llm-wiki.service` only if it still does not answer; where pm2 runs it, read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs llm-wiki --lines 200 --nostream` in auto-sns-agent instead. Search not answering: in auto-sns-agent read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs search --lines 200 --nostream`, find the cause, and restart it with that pm2 only if it still does not answer. Convex or crawler: run `node scripts/dev/devstack.mjs status` and follow ops/runbooks/local-runtime.md. Restarting: find the root (dev-guard.mjs logs exits; `Stopping app` in .cache/pm2-dev/pm2.log is a restart command) and start one job that fixes it with `commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name>`. Tell the owner what broke and whether it answers now. Mac unusable minutes: read the owners and groups of those minutes in the Mac usable watch lines (~/.prime/agent/browser-chat/mac-usable/), cut what an agent started, and name any thread to pause, without opening or moving windows on his screen (c103). Mac dev servers not answering: read that app's pm2 log on the Mac, find the cause, and give the fix to the job or chat that owns the app. All on target: no message.
